title: Urantia Foundation's Index of The Urantia Book
description: Official index published by Urantia Foundation to assist readers in locating specific topics within The Urantia Book.

title: Term List and Pronunciation Guide for The Urantia Book
description: A reference guide listing key terms and their pronunciation as they appear in The Urantia Book.

title: The Urantia Book Concordance
description: Comprehensive concordance allowing readers to find every occurrence of words and phrases throughout The Urantia Book.

title: An Artist's Conception of the Master Universe
description: A visual and conceptual representation of the master universe as described in The Urantia Book.

title: General Organization of The Urantia Book
description: An outline of the structure and general organization of The Urantia Book, by William S. Sadler, Jr.

title: The Urantia Book Workbook Series
description: A series of in-depth workbooks designed for structured study of The Urantia Book, originally compiled by Dr. William S. Sadler, Sr.

title: A Study of the Master Universe and Accompanying Appendices
description: An extensive study of the master universe cosmology as presented in The Urantia Book, with appendices by William S. Sadler, Jr.

title: Concerning Human Survival
description: An examination of questions such as 'will few or many be saved?' By M. H. Kagan, with a rebuttal by William S. Sadler, Jr.

title: Consideration of Some Criticisms of The Urantia Book
description: Published circa 1960, this is a list of 18 common doubts from those times with answers to each. By Dr. William S. Sadler.

title: How The Urantia Papers Came to Be
description: Excerpts from The Urantia Book concerning the nature of an epochal revelation. Compiled by Ralph Zehr.

title: A Strategy and Practice for In-depth Study Groups of The Urantia Book
description: Advice on strategy and practice for running in-depth study groups of The Urantia Book. By Georges Michelson-Dupont.

title: The Value of Study Groups
description: Learned experience about the value and practice of effectively leading a study group for The Urantia Book. By Gard Jameson.

title: Transcriptions of Talks by Bill Sadler
description: William S. Sadler, Jr. was one of the first known scholars of The Urantia Book. Circa 1960, a number of his talks were recorded. This is a transcript of those talks.

title: The Unceasing Campaign of the Master Seraphim
description: An essay exploring the work of master seraphim as described in The Urantia Book. By Neal Waldrop.

title: About the Standard Reference Text
description: Explains how Urantia Foundation ensures the text of The Urantia Book is preserved inviolate. Lists minor textual corrections that have been adopted.

title: TruthBook Forum Archive
description: A web discussion forum active from 2005 to 2024, now available as a searchable archive with thousands of topics on subjects related to The Urantia Book.

title: The Paramony Online
description: A fully web-based cross-reference between The Urantia Book and the Holy Bible. First published in the 1980s; offered by The Urantia Book Fellowship at no charge.

title: Webster's 1913 Dictionary
description: A free web-based historic dictionary that helps clarify the meanings of words used in The Urantia Book, whose language reflects early 20th-century usage.

title: Study Group Directory
description: Find a Urantia Book study group near you. Groups meet in person and virtually around the world to engage with other readers and benefit from multiple perspectives.
